name: html-button-style-fidelity-unstyled-default
description: Negative case: a button-class anchor with no explicit resolved surface or role remains a paragraph anchor. Conservative semantics prevent WordPress default button chrome from being fabricated for textual links.

source_reference.notes: Generic style-fidelity negative fixture: class names alone do not establish button semantics.

legacy_comparison.reason: New native button style-fidelity behavior has no legacy equivalent.
